description: Otto will forgive the crew's tab — all of it — if the Brew Plan actually happens. She's seen a lot of plans. She'd like to see one work.

objectives.text: Pull off the Brew Plan at the Supply Works

accept_text: Blow up a loading dock, get a day off, and I'll wipe the slate. Not literally. The slate's load-bearing.
progress_text: Still here? The Supply Works isn't going to accidentally explode itself. Well. It might. Don't count on it.
complete_text: Tab's cleared. Forty-one coins and one apology, gone. Here — on the house. Don't tell anyone the house has things.

description: Hic needs scrap wire and a dead battery to keep his duffel-bag armoury running. The Doctrine's bins are full of both.
accept_text: Three wires. One battery. And if you find a bottle opener, that's not for the guns, that's for me.
progress_text: *hic* The parts. Where are the... you don't have the parts. Okay. I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting. I'm at a bar.
complete_text: Beautiful. Look at this wire. It's got character. Take this charm — it's lucky. It's been lucky for me. Look how lucky I am.

description: Benno says Foreman Grisk hides something in the squeaky crate on the Supply Works loading dock. Every day is an emergency.

objectives.text: Search the squeaky crate on the Supply Works dock

accept_text: Second crate from the water. It squeaks. If it doesn't squeak, it's a Warden. Run.
progress_text: Still haven't checked the crate? It squeaks. You can't miss it. Unless you're deaf. Are you deaf? Blink twice.
complete_text: A chip taped under the lid? 'FOR EMERGENCIES — G.' Ha! Grisk's emergency is now our emergency. Keep it. I'll buy the next round. No I won't.

description: Sly wants to know if the Drunken Oracle can really call cards before they're dealt. He's too proud to ask her himself.

objectives.text: Ask the Drunken Oracle what card Sly is holding

accept_text: Go ask the old lady what's in my hand. Don't tell her I sent you. She knows I sent you. Don't tell her anyway.
progress_text: Well? What did she say? You didn't ask. I can tell. Your face has one shadow. That's a tell.
complete_text: The Queen of Nothing, she said? ...That's not even a card. That's exactly the card. Here, take an Ace. I've got spares. I've got a *lot* of spares.

description: Sly will teach the crew his trade if they prove they can play dirty where it counts: against a Doctrine Warden, in the field.
accept_text: Two Wardens. Doesn't matter how. The deck doesn't care how. The deck only cares that you came back to shuffle it.
progress_text: Wardens don't knock themselves over. Mostly. There was one time. He was drunker than Hic.
complete_text: Here. The Static Joker. It picks its own table. Looks like it picked yours. Welcome to the back table, cheat.
